rule.description: Network buffer allocation failure detected under high socket load
rule.summary: Socket buffer pool exhaustion can cause incoming packet drops under heavy network traffic.
rule.generic: Review net.core.rmem_max and sysctl network buffer configurations.
rule.reason: Observed ring buffer overflow events on network interfaces during traffic spikes.
rule.more_info: Tune tcp_rmem and tcp_wmem parameters accordingly.

resolution_set.resolution: Increase net.core.rmem_max via sysctl tuning profile.

resolution.resolution: Increase net.core.rmem_max via sysctl tuning profile.

rule.description: CFS scheduler task group imbalance causing thread stalls
rule.summary: Misconfigured CPU quota bandwidth periods can throttle critical daemon threads.
rule.generic: Inspect systemd cgroup slice CPUQuota and CPUPeriod configurations.
rule.reason: CPU bandwidth controller throttled multi-threaded service workers prematurely.
rule.more_info: Adjust cpu.cfs_quota_us settings to prevent latency spikes.

resolution_set.resolution: Update systemd slice CPU quota definitions to avoid throttling.

resolution.resolution: Update systemd slice CPU quota definitions to avoid throttling.

rule.description: Deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 protocol suites enabled on crypto policy
rule.summary: Legacy TLS ciphers expose encrypted communications to known downgrade vulnerabilities.
rule.generic: Switch crypto policies to DEFAULT or FUTURE profile.
rule.reason: System crypto policy permits CBC cipher suites with SHA-1 signatures.
rule.more_info: Execute update-crypto-policies --set DEFAULT to remediate.

resolution_set.resolution: Apply default system-wide cryptographic policies.

resolution.resolution: Apply default system-wide cryptographic policies.

rule.description: Filesystem inode depletion imminent on root volume
rule.summary: Ext4/XFS metadata space over 90% utilization due to small temporary file accumulation.
rule.generic: Identify and clean up abandoned directory trees in /var/tmp and /tmp.
rule.reason: Inode count exceeds threshold with fewer than 5% free inodes remaining.
rule.more_info: Automate tmpfiles.d purging rules to clean ephemeral sockets.

resolution_set.resolution: Configure tmpfiles cleanup service to prune stale temporary files.

resolution.resolution: Configure tmpfiles cleanup service to prune stale temporary files.

rule.description: NVMe drive controller command aborts under write pressure
rule.summary: Controller timeout values on PCIe SSD arrays require driver firmware matching.
rule.generic: Update nvme driver options in modprobe.d with extended timeout values.
rule.reason: Host controller reset events recorded in kernel ring buffer during sync.
rule.more_info: Set nvme_core.default_ps_max_latency_us kernel boot parameter.

resolution_set.resolution: Add nvme_core latency parameters to GRUB kernel command line.

resolution.resolution: Add nvme_core latency parameters to GRUB kernel command line.

rule.description: Slab unfreeable dentry cache growth causes kernel OOM
rule.summary: Repeated stat calls on missing files populate dentry negative caches uncontrollably.
rule.generic: Tune vm.vfs_cache_pressure to reclaim dentry objects more aggressively.
rule.reason: Dentry cache occupies more than 40% of available physical memory.
rule.more_info: Set vm.vfs_cache_pressure = 150 in /etc/sysctl.d/99-vfs.conf.

resolution_set.resolution: Configure vfs_cache_pressure sysctl parameter.

resolution.resolution: Configure vfs_cache_pressure sysctl parameter.

rule.description: SELinux policy prevents container runtime socket binding
rule.summary: Container daemon socket transitions denied under targeted enforcement policy.
rule.generic: Install updated container-selinux policy package matching current CRI-O.
rule.reason: Audit logs show repeated avc: denied { connectto } for container socket.
rule.more_info: Upgrade container-selinux to version 2.189 or later.

resolution_set.resolution: Update container-selinux RPM to latest errata release.

resolution.resolution: Update container-selinux RPM to latest errata release.

rule.description: Chrony time synchronization offset exceeds cluster threshold
rule.summary: Clock jitter above 500ms degrades Raft consensus and Kerberos token validation.
rule.generic: Configure dedicated local NTP pool servers in /etc/chrony.conf.
rule.reason: Chrony tracking reports systemic offset drift from stratum 1 source.
rule.more_info: Add makestep directives to resync clock slewing safely.

resolution_set.resolution: Update chrony NTP server sources and restart service.

resolution.resolution: Update chrony NTP server sources and restart service.

rule.description: Unrestricted management ports open on default firewalld zone
rule.summary: Cockpit web console and SSH listen on public network interface without rate limiting.
rule.generic: Restrict management services to internal VPN subnet zones.
rule.reason: Firewalld default zone 'public' exposes port 9090 to all inbound routes.
rule.more_info: Move external interface to drop or restricted zone.

resolution_set.resolution: Remove management service ports from public firewalld zone.

resolution.resolution: Remove management service ports from public firewalld zone.

rule.description: Excessive anonymous page swapping degrading I/O throughput
rule.summary: Swappiness value configured too aggressively for mixed database workloads.
rule.generic: Reduce vm.swappiness parameter to prevent background dirty page eviction.
rule.reason: Kswapd daemon CPU usage spikes above 80% during transaction peaks.
rule.more_info: Set vm.swappiness = 10 in tuned profile.

resolution_set.resolution: Apply enterprise-storage tuned profile with lower swappiness.

resolution.resolution: Apply enterprise-storage tuned profile with lower swappiness.

rule.description: LVM volume group metadata area exhaustion risk
rule.summary: Repeated snapshot allocation without pruning saturates VG metadata ring buffers.
rule.generic: Increase volume group metadata size or archive obsolete snapshot tags.
rule.reason: Volume group vg00 metadata area usage exceeds 88% capacity.
rule.more_info: Execute vgcfgbackup and prune stale logical volume tags.

resolution_set.resolution: Archive and prune expired thin snapshot metadata.

resolution.resolution: Archive and prune expired thin snapshot metadata.

rule.description: Audit subsystem backlog limit overflow dropping security events
rule.summary: Default audit backlog queue of 8192 records overflows during container startup bursts.
rule.generic: Increase audit_backlog_limit kernel boot argument to 32768.
rule.reason: Audit daemon recorded audit: backlog limit exceeded error codes.
rule.more_info: Update audit.rules buffer and backlog limit settings.

resolution_set.resolution: Update audit_backlog_limit in GRUB bootloader parameters.

resolution.resolution: Update audit_backlog_limit in GRUB bootloader parameters.

rule.description: Network bonding interface failover misconfigured with ARP monitor
rule.summary: Simultaneous use of miimon and arp_interval leads to bonding state flappings.
rule.generic: Standardize on MII monitoring for 802.3ad link aggregation configurations.
rule.reason: Slave interface dropped carrier without primary failover trigger.
rule.more_info: Remove arp_interval option from NetworkManager connection file.

resolution_set.resolution: Configure bonding master to use exclusively miimon carrier tracking.

resolution.resolution: Configure bonding master to use exclusively miimon carrier tracking.

rule.description: Systemd-journald disk space quota allows uncontrolled /var/log expansion
rule.summary: Unset SystemMaxUse directives permit journal files to consume up to 10% of root fs.
rule.generic: Define SystemMaxUse and SystemKeepFree in /etc/systemd/journald.conf.
rule.reason: System log volume utilization exceeds storage retention threshold.
rule.more_info: Cap persistent log consumption at 4GB.

resolution_set.resolution: Set SystemMaxUse=4G in journald configuration and restart service.

resolution.resolution: Set SystemMaxUse=4G in journald configuration and restart service.

rule.description: Kerberos replay cache file locking contention on NFS root mounts
rule.summary: Storage of rcache files on network filesystems causes POSIX lock starvation.
rule.generic: Relocate KRB5RCACHEDIR to memory-backed tmpfs mount.
rule.reason: SSSD auth timeouts recorded due to rcache file locks held by krb5 libraries.
rule.more_info: Add KRB5RCACHEDIR=/dev/shm to environment configuration.

resolution_set.resolution: Configure SSSD systemd override to set local rcache path.

resolution.resolution: Configure SSSD systemd override to set local rcache path.

rule.description: Orphaned child processes leaking PID entries in sub-cgroups
rule.summary: Custom process monitor fails to reap exit status, exhausting kernel PID table.
rule.generic: Run containerized workloads with dumb-init or tini subreaper process.
rule.reason: Defunct process count exceeds 1500 in service slice.
rule.more_info: Set TasksMax directive on systemd service unit.

resolution_set.resolution: Deploy init wrapper for service daemon and configure TasksMax.

resolution.resolution: Deploy init wrapper for service daemon and configure TasksMax.
